title: maackia australis
intro: Maackia australis, commonly known as Australian maackia or New Zealand maackia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is a small to medium-sized tree or shrub native to Australia and New Zealand. Maackia australis has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
